 Karnali Yaks set 181-run target for Kathmandu Gorkhas 
 Nepal News 
 November 2, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: The Karnali Yaks scored 180 runs for the loss of six wickets in 20 overs, setting a target of 181 runs for Kathmandu Gorkhas in their Nepal Premier League (NPL) match at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur on Monday.
 Opener Ariful Islam top-scored with 44 runs off 22 balls, including five fours and three sixes. Hussain Talat made 40 off 30 balls, while Pawan Sarraf remained unbeaten on 30 off 23 balls. Gulshan Jha added 20 off 12 balls.
 Talat and Sarraf steadied the innings with a 65-run partnership for the fifth wicket after Karnali slipped to 78 for four. Sarraf and Jha then added 28 runs off 16 balls.
 Kathmandu captain Karan KC took two wickets, while Shahab Alam, Zahandaan Khan, Dev Shah and Santosh Yadav claimed one each. Kathmandu are now set to begin their chase.
